identity.title: Structural Integrity Of Reactor Building Component Cooling Water Cracked Threaded Fitting Could Not Be Established Resulting In System Inoperable Longer Than Allowed By Technical Specifications

cause.proximate_text: The structural integrity of the piping to the 'C' RCP motor lower bearing cooler, which includes a flange and threaded piece, could not be established after a crack was identified in the threaded fitting, resulting in the RBCCW train being declared inoperable longer than allowed by Technical Specifications.
cause.theme: cracked threaded pipe fitting causing indeterminate structural integrity

nodes.theme: cracked threaded pipe fitting causing indeterminate structural integrity

nodes.display_name: Threaded fitting / flange, inlet piping to lower bearing cooler

nodes.description: A crack was identified in the threaded piece of the inlet piping to the 'C' RCP motor lower bearing cooler.

nodes.display_name: Structural integrity of piping could not be established
nodes.description: Following discovery of the crack, structural integrity of the flange/threaded piece could not be established.

nodes.display_name: RBCCW train inoperable longer than TS Allowed Outage Time
Replace leaking inlet piping (flange and threaded piece) on 'C' RCP
Additional corrective action per Corrective Action Program

chain: cracked threaded fitting [cause TBD] -> structural integrity of piping to 'C' RCP motor lower bearing cooler could not be established -> RBCCW train declared inoperable beyond TS AOT [opposite RBCCW header available as backup for safety shutdown]
